query:
SELECT 
  state_code, state_name, status, rating,
  candidate1_name, candidate1_party,
  candidate2_name, candidate2_party,
  incumbent, incumbent_party,
  primary_date, called_winner, pct_reporting
FROM senate_races
WHERE primary_date LIKE '%2026%' AND (
  primary_date LIKE '%May%' OR 
  primary_date LIKE '%Jun%'
)
AND state_code NOT IN ('AL','CA','CO','GA','IA','ID','KY','LA','ME','MT')
ORDER BY primary_date, state_code;
